title: Apollo Crossover Feeder II — Cayman Master-Feeder Onboarding with Digital Asset Custody Annex
initialRequestBrief: Apollo Global is onboarding "Apollo Crossover Feeder II" (Cayman Master-Feeder). Requires Joint Non-US Institutional LP Signers (W-8BEN-E), Sovereign Wealth Side Letter MFN tiers ($15M threshold), CIMA 10% AML UBO look-through, and a net-new Digital Asset Hardware Wallet Custody Attestation Annex.

comparisonResults.howPastCaseWent: Joint non-US signers deadlocked at the W-8BEN-E step when a co-signer reviewed Part XXIX while the primary elected Active NFFE; UAT sign-off and the initial close slipped 9 days until the v2 schema gave the elections to one Designated Tax Signatory.
pitfallWarnings: Only the Designated Tax Signatory may edit the Chapter 4 and CRS elections; co-signers attest.
Run joint-signer UAT with concurrent sessions in both signer orders, not one tester driving each signer.

deltaItems.pastApproach: State-isolated Step 4: elections owned by the Annex B Designated Tax Signatory, rules on committed state, one DocuSign anchor per recipient.
deltaItems.currentRequirement: Brief 2.2: two authorised signatories per non-US institution, only one makes the Chapter 4 and CRS elections, both sign in DocuSign.
deltaItems.actionRecommendation: Reuse cayman_fatca_v2.json unchanged apart from parameters; confirm with Apollo's counsel which signatory clause and annex define the Designated Tax Signatory.

deltaItems.category: Joint-signer onboarding SOP and UAT script
deltaItems.pastApproach: SOP with kickoff role mapping, build rules, concurrent-session UAT and the 16-scenario exception matrix.
deltaItems.currentRequirement: Same joint-signer population; UAT window 16 Nov to 4 Dec.
deltaItems.actionRecommendation: Run the SOP's kickoff checklist on 19 Oct and schedule the exception matrix into UAT week 1.

deltaItems.category: Digital Asset Hardware Wallet Custody Attestation Annex (Annex D)
deltaItems.pastApproach: No precedent in the Memory Bank.
deltaItems.currentRequirement: Brief 2.5: cold-storage attestation, signed-message proof of wallet control, multisig key holders linked to KYC, chain-analytics sanctions screening and Travel Rule undertakings.
deltaItems.actionRecommendation: Flag for custom legal and operations scoping before quoting; Legal to draft the annex, Engineering to scope per-chain address validation and signature verification.

comparisonResults.howPastCaseWent: Counsel lowered the UBO threshold to 10% with four-tier look-through 48 hours before go-live; a parameterised recursive schema and an in-place draft migration kept the close on time with no investor restarting.
pitfallWarnings: Keep the comparator with the number: "10% or more" is inclusive.
Never edit a threshold in place on a published schema; version and migrate.

deltaItems.pastApproach: Recursive four-tier repeater; strict 10% inclusive threshold applied to high-risk exposure and multi-tier investors through a scope toggle.
deltaItems.currentRequirement: Brief 2.4: 10% or more for every investing entity, traced up to four tiers, without losing progress if the threshold changes.
deltaItems.actionRecommendation: Reuse ubo_4tier_lookthrough_schema.json and set strict_lookthrough_applies_to to ALL_INVESTORS with an audit entry citing counsel's 30 September 2026 memo.

deltaItems.category: AML compliance guide and section references
deltaItems.pastApproach: Guide written for a Luxembourg RAIF under the AML Law of 12 November 2004 and CSSF rules.
deltaItems.currentRequirement: Cayman feeder under the AML Regulations and CIMA guidance, as interpreted by Apollo's Cayman counsel.
deltaItems.actionRecommendation: Keep the parameter-to-clause method from Section 8 of the guide but re-map every reference to the Cayman subscription agreement; never cite Luxembourg law for a Cayman fund.

comparisonResults.howPastCaseWent: Two sovereign LPs rejected the investor indemnity and demanded global fee visibility; four redline rounds over three weeks produced a pre-approved immunity reservation clause and MFN fee disclosure brackets at US$25M and US$50M+.
pitfallWarnings: Tag every status-based sovereign concession as an Excluded Provision, or every LP at the MFN threshold can elect it.

deltaItems.category: Sovereign immunity reservation and indemnity carve-out
deltaItems.pastApproach: Pre-approved clause-library text: immunities reserved, commercial obligations binding, set-off capped at the value of the Interest, both excluded from the MFN.
deltaItems.currentRequirement: Brief 2.3: two sovereign investors who cannot give the indemnity or submit to jurisdiction.
deltaItems.actionRecommendation: Open negotiations with the Round 3/4 language from the approved redlines instead of a blank draft.

deltaItems.pastApproach: First bracket at US$25M-49.99M aggregate commitment; US$50M+ sees all fee terms.
deltaItems.currentRequirement: First bracket starts at US$15M aggregate commitment.
deltaItems.actionRecommendation: Copy mfn_tier_eligibility_matrix.csv, lower the first bracket from US$25M to US$15M and re-check which fee terms each bracket sees; keep affiliate aggregation.

artifacts.description: Apollo's implementation request: fund overview, scope (joint signers, sovereign MFN at US$15M, 10% look-through, digital asset custody annex), timeline and the GP's questions.
